image_prompt.text: Waist-high crates and full-body concrete barriers scattered evenly across every lane of the arena
Mirrored team bases at opposite ends of the arena, shielded from the sniper towers' sightlines
Narrow industrial pinch points where the symmetrical lanes meet, concentrating team-vs-team fights onto contested ground
Elevated platforms, catwalks, and a sniper tower at each end, reachable only by exposed stairs and ladders
Multiple concrete-and-metal buildings breached through doorways and fired from through windows
Modern industrial urban-warfare aesthetic throughout — poured concrete, corrugated metal, exposed steel

layout_placement.text: Two opposing team spawns at opposite ends of the map, balanced and out of the sniper towers' lines

notes: Prompt says "tactical", but it describes symmetrical lanes, team-vs-team engagements and mirrored opposite ends — that is the arcade read, not the MilSim breach-sequence one, so lane-network and the Team Deathmatch preset were kept rather than breach-sequence.

Preset Team Deathmatch taken whole (shape lane-network, spawn-teambase, cover-los, choke-bottleneck) with building-interior and cover-elevated added for the buildings and the catwalks/sniper towers. Nothing dropped.

cover-elevated is P0 + tiered unless it overhangs; catwalks are suspended walkways over the floor below, so it was taken as P2. If they are built as terraces flush against the buildings instead, this drops back to the proven pipeline.
building-interior carries P3: doorways and windows used for cover mean players go inside, not facades.
Deferral: P3 and P2 are not ready yet, so the interiors-generated-separately and overhanging-catwalk passes are noted for when they are.

No option covers the request to expose wall height, building count and cover density as tunable attributes — it is a generation-parameter request rather than map geometry, carried here for the pipeline.
"Medium-sized" is a scale band, not a count; no explicit quantities were stated, so no count fields are set ("multiple buildings" and "sniper towers at opposite ends" give no number).

would have asked: Sounds like a team deathmatch arena — mirrored bases at opposite ends, symmetrical lanes between them, crates and barriers for cover, and pinch points where the lanes meet. I'd add the breachable concrete buildings and the catwalk/sniper-tower firing positions you described. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: are the catwalks suspended over the floor below, or terraces flush against the buildings? Suspended walkways need the overhanging-surface pass, which isn't ready yet; terraces would keep this on the pipeline that is running today.
would have asked: do players actually go inside the buildings, or are the doorways and windows only shooting positions on a facade? Real interiors are generated separately, which is a slower build.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
